How our adult ADHD assessment is put together, and why.

The Australian ADHD guideline says a diagnosis should not rest on rating scales alone, so our assessment is built around gathering the whole picture. Before we meet, four questionnaires arrive one at a time: attention and mood, sleep and health, growing up, and daily life. Across two appointments we look at your childhood and development, your health and sleep, how things work day to day, and input from someone who knows you well, if you choose. Where a question about autism, mood or substance use comes up, targeted follow-up questionnaires help answer it.

You receive a full written report, a letter for your GP, and, if you want to discuss medication, a report written for a psychiatrist. We developed our psychiatry pathway with Dr Luisa Fernandez of North Psychiatry. With a GP referral, our report goes to her, and she completes the picture with her own assessment and any medical care. Therapy with us stays optional.

Kew, Croydon and online. Learn more at equalpsychology.com.au/services/adhd

Not sure where to start? The Meet and Greet is a free 15-minute call or in-person meeting, no obligation, to see if we are the right fit before committing to anything.
